title: Greek professor says the Delphic women were literally possessed by the spirit of Zeus

tellings.quote: I've heard I've heard Greek uh professors say that you know these women who would become uh like as the vapors came up under the ground of Deli and the woman would become possessed with the spirit of Zeus.

plain: At Delphi, the ancient Greek site of a famous oracle, women are said to have been possessed by the spirit of Zeus, the chief Greek god, as vapours rose from under the ground. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells this on the show, saying he has heard unnamed Greek professors describe it. If true, it would mean the oracle's trances were real possession, not only ritual.
